selection.basis: pinned after reading the corrected development trajectories; selected by task ambiguity, semantic relationships, and observed baseline payload/turn cost rather than repository size

developmentReadBeforeSelection.note: These development observations selected the holdout shape. They are not certification results and are never reused as holdout evidence.

cases.reason: A unique exported constant exercises exact declaration lookup with a low baseline search cardinality.
Ten source files mention IndexStatusType, so the case spans baseline name ambiguity without a repository-size proxy.
Callers of one pagination helper require a reference relationship rather than a literal declaration match.
A common SQLite connection symbol produces roughly 100 baseline grep lines, so it spans the costly baseline payload shape observed in development.

execution.reason: Holdout cases stay unexecuted in this development pilot so no development observation is reused as certification evidence.

certificationBoundary: Only a later predeclared certification campaign may execute these cases. This record cannot authorize a release and cannot be merged with development executions.
